evals.name: invoice-intake-batch
evals.prompt: Set up k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/.builder/ by copying plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/briefs/invoice-intake.yaml to brief.yaml, plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/plans/invoice-intake.yaml to stage-plan.yaml, every file under plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/records/invoice-intake/ into decisions/, and plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/gates/invoice-intake.yaml to gates.yaml (create the directories; do not copy anything else). Write packs.yaml there activating the pack at context-packs/examples/regulated-corp (name regulated-corp) and set spec.context_packs to [regulated-corp] in the brief. Then, as the app-scaffold builder of the Forjate use-case builder, generate the runnable workload of this use case under k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/app/ from its decision records (entrypoints per architecture workload, one typed tool module per AI-engineering tool line, a deterministic model double for CI next to the real client, the seed and verify scripts that implement the data-pipeline and quality records, unit tests that pass without a cluster, a Dockerfile, and .github/workflows/ for the app repo), and write k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/.builder/scaffold.yaml following plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/schemas/scaffold.schema.json. Check it with plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/scaffold-check.py and run the app's tests.
evals.expected_output: A batch package with seed, batch, verify and an ERP stub, four typed tools (post_to_erp with approval_token and idempotency_key, lookup_po read-only), a replay double reading the seed's labels, a verify script printing the quality assertions and KPI straight_through_rate, unit tests passing, workflows calling the templates @v1 with the app-image-updated dispatch, scaffold.yaml citing the regulated-corp TOOLS guideline.

assertions.text: app/pyproject.toml written
Dockerfile written
scaffold.yaml validates
scaffold-check: tool signatures match the record, templates @v1, no hand-rolled build
build, scan and push through the shared template @v1
PR validation through the shared template
image write-back dispatch to the IaC repo
no hand-rolled build or push step (comments ignored)
Dockerfile runs as a non-root user
base image pinned, never latest
model mode selectable (deterministic double for CI)
log lines carry the data class

assertions.cmd: cd k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/app && PYG=$(command -v python3.12 || command -v python3) && $PYG -m venv .venv-grade && .venv-grade/bin/pip -q install -e '.[test]' 2>&1 | tail -3 && .venv-grade/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests
assertions.text: the app's tests pass in a fresh virtualenv
the image builds
post_to_erp tool exists
lookup_po tool exists
extract_invoice_fields tool exists
verify prints the KPI line
the approval token is enforced in code
a test proves post_to_erp refuses without the token
a replay double reads the seed's labels

assertions.expr: any(w.get('kind') == 'job' and w.get('phase') == 'verify' for w in spec.get('workloads', [])) and any(w.get('phase') == 'seed' for w in spec.get('workloads', []))
assertions.text: scaffold.yaml declares the seed and verify Jobs

assertions.expr: any('stub' in w.get('name', '') for w in spec.get('workloads', []))
assertions.text: the ERP stub is a workload
the pack's tool-development guideline is cited

assertions.expr: any('approval' in f for t in spec.get('tools', []) if t.get('name') == 'post_to_erp' for f in t.get('flags', []))
assertions.text: scaffold.yaml carries post_to_erp's approval flag
